label: A GOD_4 with will that is GOOD_4 in esse wills that GOOD_4 for itself
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, OPEN bridge, attribution deferred (ST I q.19 a.1 / q.20 a.1 theme). For every GOD_4 g with will that is good in esse, g wills that good in esse to itself. Needed because the stage-2 supreme-goodness predicate concerns causation of distinct beings only; the unary HAS_WILL_1 predicate records no object of willing.
